text:
alex: Quick heads-up: I'm going to add a safelock to config-operator to prevent concurrent applies during snapshot restores. want an ops handoff + telemetry contract before I flip it.
priya: SG. which telemetry signals are you planning? error_count, apply_duration, safelock_acquired? :eyes:
dan: +1. We need a counter for safelock acquisitions, a gauge for active locks, and a histogram for apply_duration (ms). Also emit a span for the apply lifecycle so we can tie slow applies to other infra events.
emily: Also add an audit event per-tenant: attempt, outcome (acquired|skipped|timed_out), and diff-id. Last rollback we couldn't trace who triggered the reapply.
alex: implementation plan: 1) metrics: config.apply.safelock_acquired (counter), config.apply.active_locks (gauge), config.apply.duration_ms (histogram) 2) span: op.config.apply with attributes {tenant_id, snapshot_id, operator_version, diff_id} 3) audit events to tenant timeline 4) console: show safelock state + dry-run diff link in preview panel 5) feature-flagged rollout (0.1 cohort -> 10 tenants -> ramp) 6) 24h dry-run window before enforcement. testing locally: ```./configctl apply --safelock --snapshot=2026-03-22T09:00Z --dry-run```
priya: tiny telemetry contract notes: metric names must be snake_case, tags: tenant_id, operator_version, cluster, and we enforce unit_ms for durations. include example payloads in the PR. I'll draft the contract doc.
dan: Ops guardrails: auto-pause the canary if any of these happen: a) a single apply spans > 10m b) 95th pct apply_duration increases > 5x baseline c) config.apply.active_locks exceeds expected concurrency (default 1). Alert should include tenant_id, diff_id, and recent apply spans. Runbook step: 'pause rollout' -> 'inspect locks' -> 'force-release if safe' -> 'kick off audit-review'. I'll add snippets to pager-runbook.
emily: Console UX: show a yellow banner while safelock is in dry-run with a link to "View dry-run diff" and an "Audit" quick-link. When enforced, show a red banner for blocked applies with a CTA: Request override (SRE-only) which creates an audit entry and sends a DM to #eng-oncall.
alex: question: how do we want the override flow to work? prefer SRE-only toggle that requires justification text and creates an audit entry + emitted metric config.apply.override_requested.
dan: yes. also ensure the override can't be used to bypass snapshot-consistency checks; it should release the lock after a force-release API call. Force-release should be rate-limited and require justification.
priya: for sampling: high-volume tenants should sample spans at 1% by default, but counters and gauges must always export. we'll document sample_rate in the telemetry contract and have a console toggle per-tenant.
emily: Can we show a small timeline in the preview with the last 5 apply events (status + duration) so PMs can quickly see recent failures?
alex: good idea. will add that to the console mock. rollout timeline: PR today, code-review + telemetry review by EOD, merge + 24h dry-run flagged for 10 tenants, canary for 48h, ramp if telemetry gates pass. gates: no applies >10m, 95p <= 2x baseline, no unknown audit gaps. If any gate fails -> auto-pause and notify #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deployment config-operator-canary at 2026-03-22T16:00Z to cluster-canary-2. CI green. :white_check_mark:
alex: assign owners: alex = impl, priya = telemetry contract + schema examples, dan = alerting/runbook, emily = console UX + audit links, SRE = override policy + ops handoff.
priya: nit: prefer metric suffix _total for counters (config.apply.safelock_acquired_total) and _seconds for histograms historically, but fine to keep ms if we document it.
dan: i'll align alerts to the prometheus conventions. add alert: ConfigApplyStuck if sum(rate(config_apply_safelock_acquired_total[5m])) > 0 and sum(config_apply_active_locks) > 0 and avg(config_apply_duration_ms[15m]) > 600000ms -> trigger.
emily: small privacy note: don't include full diffs in telemetry; diffs should be referenced by diff_id and stored behind auth. console can fetch diffs with permissions.
alex: ack. I'll open the PR and tag you all. will include example events and a short simulation in CI to validate metrics emission. will post PR link here. :rocket:
